ar.title: عجة المخ

steps.n1: يُسلق المخ قليلاً في ماء مملح، يُصفى، تُزال الأوردة ويُهرس.
steps.n2: يُلين البصل في السمن، يُضاف الثوم ويُقلى حتى يصير ذهبياً مع التحريك المستمر، ثم تُرفع المقلاة عن النار.
steps.n3: يُخفق البيض ويُضاف إليه المخ والبصل والثوم وعصير الليمون والبقدونس والملح والفلفل.
steps.n4: يُسخن سمن أكثر ويُصب خليط البيض. مع تماسك القاع، يُرفع الطرف لينسكب البيض السائل تحته.
steps.n5: تُقلب العجة وتُقلى حتى يصبح الجانبان ذهبياً ومتماسكاً.

en.title: Brain Omelet (Ijjit Nukha'aat)
en.intro: Recipe 70, page 32 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

steps.n1: Parboil the brain in salted water, drain it, remove the veins and mash it.
steps.n2: Soften the onion in ghee, add the garlic and fry until golden, stirring all the time, then take the pan off the heat.
steps.n3: Beat the eggs and stir in the brain, the onion and garlic, the lemon juice, parsley, salt and pepper.
steps.n4: Heat more ghee and pour in the egg mixture. As the bottom sets, lift the edge so the runny egg flows underneath.
steps.n5: Turn the omelet and fry until both sides are golden and set.
steps.n6: Cut into thick wedges and serve.

legacySteps: Parboil the brain in salted water, drain it, remove the veins and mash it.
Soften the onion in ghee, add the garlic and fry until golden, stirring all the time, then take the pan off the heat.
Beat the eggs and stir in the brain, the onion and garlic, the lemon juice, parsley, salt and pepper.
Heat more ghee and pour in the egg mixture. As the bottom sets, lift the edge so the runny egg flows underneath.
Turn the omelet and fry until both sides are golden and set.
Cut into thick wedges and serve.
